Name: Ferm's Seasonal Elliott Replacement
Author: Fermter
Description:
For those who like the "hunky" version of Elliott, this mod replaces his portraits from Poltergeister's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] mod with a more vanilla-esque portrait series. All five seasonal outfits, two festival outfits (only Flower Dance and Spirit's Eve so far), and beach sprites are replaced. Overworld sprites remain as they are in Seasonal Outfits. The remaining festival sprite replacements added by Seasonal Outfits are planned.

This mod is not designed to be used with any portrait replacer other than Seasonal Outfits; it should be fine as long as the portraits are not of Elliott, but combine at own risk. This mod is in "beta;" please let me know if any errors occur in any season/festival.

Credits:
Original Elliott design - ConcernedApe
Original Elliot seasonal portraits - Poltergeister, inspired by Seasonal Villager Outfits

Content Patcher - Pathoschild
Code for Content Patcher - adapted from Seasonal Outfits (updated by Ayrin, based on paradigmnomad's Seasonal Villager Outfits code)
